description: UVP unified error taxonomy: one source of truth for retry/terminal/benign classification semantics across the three producers (Go cloud engine, chain-services, executor-kit). Base fields record the currently-unified lane semantics; where producers still diverge, the divergence is recorded under producer_overrides and listed as needs-ruling in the conformance reports. Consumers pin version + sha256 and run completeness/consistency suites against this file.

field_semantics.code: Unified snake_case identifier for a cross-repo error condition.
field_semantics.condition: Human-readable trigger condition for the classification.
field_semantics.layer: One of: chain (on-chain / contract revert / receipt), transport (RPC/network), db (PostgreSQL server-side), application (business/validation/config), messaging (downstream message delivery), infra (process-local infrastructure).
field_semantics.producers: Repos that classify this condition: go-cloud-engine | chain-services | executor-kit.
field_semantics.retryable: True when a later attempt with unchanged inputs can succeed (transient, operator-recoverable, or self-healing).
field_semantics.backoff: Retry scheduling: exponential (capped), fixed (constant window), sweep (bounded in-process retries then durable queue replay), reconcile_poll (periodic re-probe), none.
field_semantics.dead_letter: True when the failure is terminal for the submission/job path and must be parked for human triage instead of retried.
field_semantics.benign_scan_outcome: True when the condition classifies a scan skip, not a run failure: a chain-once scan that only met these must exit 0 (executor-kit chainPollExecutionFailed semantics).
field_semantics.internal_names: Producer-local identifiers (error codes, kinds, PG codes, sentinel strings) that map onto this unified code.
field_semantics.producer_overrides: Per-producer attribute patches recording still-diverging semantics; every override must appear in the needs-ruling list of the producing conformance report.

errors.condition: Gas payer balance cannot cover the broadcast (insufficient funds / insufficient balance at tx signing or eth_sendRawTransaction).
errors.notes: Route-4 unification: funding the gas payer is operator-recoverable and no txHash exists, so the same signed payload may be retried after top-up. Aligned in relayer (classifyRelaySubmitterError), submissions broadcast-adapter, and executor-kit errors.ts MESSAGE_PATTERNS.

errors.condition: The chain's own dedupe fact: SignalAlreadyExists() revert (decoded name, plain sentence, or raw selector 0xa2e92828) proves the exact signal already exists on chain.

executor-kit.notes: Executor-kit treats the dedupe fact as benign: the signal is counted delivered, the job lands in `ignored`, and a scan that only met duplicate_signal must exit 0 (BENIGN_SCAN_OUTCOME_ERROR_KINDS). Chain-services relayer/submissions instead dead-letter the submission ledger entry. Needs-ruling: unified disposition for the same on-chain fact.

errors.notes: Retryable=false everywhere (re-submitting cannot change chain state). Terminal disposition diverges: dead_letter=true in chain-services vs benign ignored in executor-kit (see producer_overrides).

errors.condition: Tx-pool / nonce race texts: nonce too low, nonce has already been used, replacement transaction underpriced, already known, same hash was already imported.

executor-kit.notes: Executor-kit recomputes the account nonce on every attempt (fresh wallet.writeContract), so a nonce race is transient and retryable. Needs-ruling vs chain-services relayer.

errors.notes: Divergent dispositions (needs-ruling): chain-services relayer classifies as duplicate_transaction — non-retryable, dead-letter, BUT first probes candidate txHashes (error-carried + previously recorded) for an on-chain receipt; a success receipt resolves the submission as submitted with the nonce consumed. chain-services submissions adapter has no nonce pattern, so these texts fall to state_machine_broadcast_failed (retryable=true fallback). executor-kit nonce_conflict retryable=true.

errors.condition: Transport/RPC faults before the request was accepted: timeouts, ETIMEDOUT/ECONNRESET/ECONNREFUSED/AbortError, HTTP 429 rate limit, 502/503/504 gateway failures, fetch failed, socket hang up.
errors.notes: Verdict aligned (retryable=true, capped exponential). Detection breadth differs: relayer (rpc_unavailable) and executor-kit (rpc_network) also match 429/rate-limit/network keywords; submissions and stage-patch adapters (rpc_timeout) match only timeout/socket keywords — a 429 there falls to the generic retryable fallback, same verdict. relayer rpc_unavailable also covers ECONNREFUSED.

errors.condition: Transaction definitively reverted: receipt status reverted/failed, or a generic execution-reverted error that is not UnknownOrder.

executor-kit: SubmitSignalReceiptError (receipt status reverted; classified through the conservative non-retryable fallback)

errors.notes: Relayer must test UnknownOrder before the generic reverted rule (viem composite text contains both). Reconcile treats receipt status reverted/failed as terminal failed/non-retryable. Executor-kit never rebroadcasts after a reverted receipt; the txHash stays on the job audit trail.

errors.condition: Broadcast happened but the outcome is not yet known or not authoritative: receipt missing, receipt status unknown/omitted, or receipt-wait transport failure with the txHash preserved.

executor-kit: SubmitSignalReceiptError (receipt wait failed; cause-classified, e.g. rpc_network, txHash kept)

errors.notes: An unknown receipt must never be classified as a revert: it stays in the reconcile/retry lane until the chain decides. Reconcile verdicts: pending (no txHash, missing receipt, unknown status) retryable=true; stale_pending (tx_reconcile_timeout) retryable=true; receipt success but projection missing -> indexing, terminal non-retryable; projection present -> confirmed. Executor-kit keeps the broadcast txHash on the job and only rebroadcasts after the receipt proves absence.

errors.condition: Contract revert UnknownOrder(): the order is not (yet) registered on the state machine.
errors.notes: Typical transient: order registration may still be propagating. The UnknownOrder check must precede the generic reverted rule in both relayer and submissions adapters (same composite-text hazard).

errors.condition: Authorization/signature rejections: unauthorized submitter or selector, invalid business/signal/stage-patch signature, verified-signer mismatch, missing verified signer, relayer key reused as participant signer.
errors.notes: Executor-kit also matches AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount / OwnableUnauthorizedAccount revert names and generic 'unauthorized' text.

errors.condition: Signature deadline has expired (preflight deadline check or on-chain ExpiredSignalSignature revert).
errors.notes: Relayer expired_payload_deadline and submissions expired_signal_signature (both the preflight check and the on-chain revert).

errors.condition: A prepared submission/stage patch aged past its validity window before broadcast (local expiry, no chain contact).
errors.notes: Terminal-expired status (not_retryable) but deliberately NOT dead-lettered: the payload simply ages out; a fresh prepare produces a new submission.

errors.condition: Configured chainId does not match the RPC endpoint's reported chain (preflight getChainId or error text).
errors.notes: Configuration defect; retry cannot fix it, operator must fix config.

errors.condition: Local concurrency guard: another broadcast for the same order/submitter is already in flight.
errors.notes: Self-healing contention (TOCTOU-safe in-flight counters); retry after the backoff window.

errors.condition: Replay/nonce-reuse dedupe on the submission path: the signer nonce is already reserved, the submission nonce was already used, or a stage-patch nonce is stale (already used on chain).
errors.notes: Lane nuances: submissions duplicate_submit answers HTTP 409 instead of dead-lettering; the stage-patch lane does not model dead_letter on its failed results, and its duplicate_/stale_stage_*_patch_nonce 409s are pre-broadcast service-layer checks of the same replay-dedupe condition. Core verdict shared: a replayed nonce is deterministic, never retried.

errors.condition: Broadcast returned a txHash already recorded for another submission (cross-submission collision).
errors.notes: safe-broadcast-adapter txHash ownership dedupe (in-memory + durable claimTxHash).

errors.condition: Retry budget for the submission is spent (maxRetryAttempts exceeded) or the last failure was non-retryable so further broadcast attempts are blocked.
errors.notes: relayer (RelayService retry budget) and safe-broadcast-adapter share the errorCode broadcast_retry_exhausted; broadcast_retry_blocked is the safe-broadcast variant when the stored last failure was non-retryable.

errors.condition: The broadcast succeeded (txHash exists) but persisting the submission/ledger record failed; the nonce is consumed and the receipt is unknown.
errors.notes: Irreversible-from-service: a txHash-bearing terminal fallback is recorded and the nonce stays reserved; blind rebroadcast would risk a second on-chain transaction.

errors.condition: The chain broadcast already succeeded (submission carries a txHash) but the server-side evidence binding (uploaded→bound with on-chain location) failed after the submit; the submission itself is unaffected.
errors.notes: Retryable because the on-chain commit is done and binding is a service-side state transition: the failed bind is audited, the evidence references stay persisted on the submission record, and the reconcile worker's evidence-bind sweep retries the binding from those references each poll until the proof reports bound.

errors.condition: Deterministic caller-input defect: payload fails validation before any side effect (missing/oversized/illegal fields, unsigned/malformed envelope, prepared submission without planId).

go-cloud-engine: statemachine.PermanentError (signal validation paths: 缺少 order_id、空白 parent_order_ids、dock 保留命名空间、超宽字段、引用不存在的阶段)
compiler zhixu_handler ValidationError (超宽标识 22001 双保险)

errors.notes: Retrying identical bytes re-fails identically. Executor-kit exception: an undecodable HookReady log is isolated as a terminal `ignored` job (isolateUndecodableLog, fallback kind validation_failure) so a mixed-ABI deployment skips instead of crashing; still non-retryable and counted in decode failures.

errors.condition: Broadcast adapter is deliberately not configured; the request is verified but no chain transaction is attempted.
errors.notes: Feature-not-configured sentinel (status not_attempted), not a failure classification.

errors.condition: Unrecognized failure with no deterministic marker, treated by default as transient infrastructure noise (DB/network hiccup, generic broadcast failure).
errors.notes: Default-retryable fallback. Divergence: executor-kit's fallback is deliberately conservative (see unknown_unclassified). Go delivery retries burn a bounded 12-round exponential budget before giving up.

errors.condition: Failure carrying neither an explicit code nor any recognized error text; conservatively treated as non-retryable for human triage.
errors.notes: Executor-kit deliberately guesses nothing: unclassifiable failures dead-letter instead of being silently retried. Needs-ruling: opposite default from go-cloud-engine/chain-services transient_infra_error fallbacks — a cross-producer port of a handler must re-classify, not copy the fallback.

errors.condition: A HookReady event matches no configured state machine handler: a foreign supplier's hook on a shared chain.
errors.notes: Benign scan outcome: a shared chain always carries other suppliers' hooks; the job is ignored and a chain-once scan that only met these must exit 0.

errors.condition: The executor's own handler callback failed after being matched (HANDLER_FAILURE code).
errors.notes: Explicit code only; handler exceptions without the code flow through the normal classifier.

errors.condition: A compiled hook AST / persisted snapshot cannot be decoded (poison payload: same bytes always fail).

go-cloud-engine: Permanentf("解析已编译 hook AST 失败") (hookdsl.DecodeCompiledHook)

errors.notes: Two lanes: hook delivery dead-letters the row immediately (re-decode of the same bytes is futile); the poke worker postpones the poison row by a fixed 1h window so one poisoned wait row cannot head-of-line block all delayed hooks (UVP-06).

errors.condition: The order/stage record carries no executor configuration, or the stored executor config JSON cannot be parsed; retry cannot grow a config.

go-cloud-engine: errNoExecutorConfig Permanentf (订单未绑定执行器配置)
dock delivery service is not configured

errors.notes: Deterministic row-level defect; last_error must point at the real cause (missing config), not a misleading JSON-unmarshal message.

errors.condition: Dock routing defect: no published dock route for the zhixu/stage, route schema/parse failures, missing identity/entrance bindings, hook not bound on route, or target zhixu not published.

go-cloud-engine: docking.Permanentf (has no published dock route / route schemaVersion / orderIdPolicy / missing identity or entrance / hook not bound / target zhixu not published)

errors.notes: Configuration is deterministic: retrying cannot publish the route.

errors.condition: PostgreSQL error codes whose outcome is fully determined by the input: 22001 string_data_right_truncation, 22003 numeric_value_out_of_range, 23503 foreign_key_violation, 23514 check_violation, P0001 raise_exception (deterministic RAISE from DDL trigger/function).

go-cloud-engine: 22003 numeric_value_out_of_range (value exceeds the column domain: e.g. an over-bound retry-times option slipping the pre-check so max_attempts overflows int4)
P0001 raise_exception (dock reserved-namespace squatting rejection raised by a DDL trigger/function; transient faults never surface as P0001)

errors.notes: Same verdict on both pgx (pgconn.PgError) and lib/pq paths. 22001 is double-guarded by the compiler-side ValidationError pre-check.

errors.condition: PostgreSQL 23505 unique_violation on concurrent first-registration: self-healing because the ON CONFLICT path makes a duplicate insert converge.
errors.notes: Deliberately kept retryable (unlike db_deterministic_violation): concurrent first registration resolves on the next attempt.

errors.condition: A downstream component explicitly declared its business failure non-retryable via httpprotocol.BusinessError{Retryable:false}; the declaration is transported along the %w chain and honored by the delivery layer.
errors.notes: The receiver side mirrors this: pkg/executors/http_receiver re-derives retryable from statemachine.PermanentError so downstream-declared non-retry semantics survive the HTTP hop; BusinessError{Retryable:true} stays in the delivery retry lane with the standard exponential backoff.

errors.condition: A post-commit side effect (signal notification / projection automation) failed after the projection cursor advanced; it must not be dropped and must not rewind the cursor.

chain-services: durable pending post-commit queue (savePendingPostCommitStep / admin-ops replay)

errors.notes: Bounded in-process retries (exponential delays), then the step is persisted to the durable pending queue; the background sweep re-delivers before each incremental refresh and dequeues on success, otherwise it stays queued with an attempt counter.
